banners.prompt:
This is a vertical photo of two hands holding an open printed book (a Canva design guide) above a table. Translate ONLY the Bulgarian text printed on the two open pages into Romanian, keeping the same page layout, fonts, sizes, colours, icons, the colour wheel, the Canva screenshots and the page numbers 42 and 43.

ABSOLUTE RULES:
- Keep the hands, sleeves, laptop, screen content, cup, plants, table, background, lighting and the whole composition EXACTLY as in the original photo. Do not alter anything except what is described below.
- Do not add watermarks, logos, captions, names or any new element.
- The image has plain white bars added along two edges purely as padding. Leave them plain white and empty. Do not extend the photo into them and do not re-centre or rescale the photo.
- Any English text (on the laptop screen, 'Canva', 'Design for Everyone', 'Good Food Brighter Days', 'Good Ideas Brighter Days') stays exactly as it is.
- No Bulgarian or Cyrillic letter may remain anywhere in the image.
- CRITICAL: Romanian only, correct diacritics ă â î ș ț (comma-below). Render them exactly.
- The hands, the fingers, the book shape and the page curvature stay exactly the same.
- Headings and key lines, use exactly these translations, character for character:
  "4. Цветове, които работят" -> "4. Culori care funcționează"
  "4.1. Цветово колело" -> "4.1. Roata culorilor"
  "Популярни цветови схеми:" -> "Scheme de culori populare:"
  "Аналогични" -> "Analoage"
  "Комплементарни" -> "Complementare"
  "Триадни" -> "Triadice"
  "Монохромни" -> "Monocrome"
  "Съвет:" -> "Sfat:"
  "4.2. Как да приложиш цветове в Canva" -> "4.2. Cum aplici culorile în Canva"
  "5. Работа с текст" -> "5. Lucrul cu textul"
  "5.1. Комбиниране на шрифтове" -> "5.1. Combinarea fonturilor"
  "Заглавие" -> "Titlu"
  "Подзаглавие" -> "Subtitlu"
  "Основен текст" -> "Text principal"
  "Примерни комбинации:" -> "Exemple de combinații:"
  "5.2. Настройки на текста в Canva" -> "5.2. Setările textului în Canva"
  "Шрифт" -> "Font"
  "Размер" -> "Mărime"
  "Цвят" -> "Culoare"
  "Подравняване" -> "Aliniere"
  "Разстояние между редовете" -> "Spațiere între rânduri"
  "Ефекти" -> "Efecte"
- The small body text lines may be any short natural Romanian sentences about colours and fonts in Canva; they must be Romanian, never Cyrillic.
- Font names (Montserrat, Open Sans, Playfair Display, Lato, Poppins, Roboto, Oswald) and 'Good Vibes Only' stay as they are.
